title: ci(console-pin): conclude on every PR and enrol Console Pin Gate in REQUIRED_CONTEXTS
body:
Part of #17673
Clause-②: no

Step 1 of ruling #18900 item ⑤ (comment 5727134555): `Console Pin Gate` reports a conclusion on every PR (a `success` on an unaffected one), and it is enrolled in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`. Step 2 is adding it to the required set in Settings → Rulesets. That is the maintainer's click after this lands, and nothing here does it.

## Design: the filter term moves from the job onto its steps

- `console-pin`'s own `if:` is now `!cancelled()` alone, so the job always runs and concludes. A job-level `if:` that is false concludes `skipped`, and branch protection counts `skipped` as passing. That was the tombstone's cause.
- Every step carries the filter term in the contract's own spelling, `needs.filter.outputs.console != 'false'`. Only an exact `'false'` skips a step, so a dead `filter` job still builds. Both halves of THE FILTER CONTRACT are kept, and `merge_group` still widens the output to `'true'`.
- On an unaffected run, only one step runs. Its `if:` is the complement (`== 'false'`), and it writes a NOT BUILT notice and a step summary. That `success` is the filter's verdict, not a build.
- One change from round 1's design: round 1 passed the verdict through a shell step output (`steps.scope.outputs.affected`). The repo's declaration readers cannot read that without trusting the shell, and that is what broke the dispatch-gates derivation. Each step's `if:` now reads the filter output directly. The rest of round 1's design is kept.

## The three required-path reds round 1 found, and how each is addressed

1. `check:required-contexts`: the set-naming census needs `platform-readings.md` to name the eighth context. It now does (see below).
2. `check:pm-expected-skips`: `Console Pin Gate` is removed from the skip-by-design roster, so a skipped one now exits 4. The measured 39-run head is kept verbatim, and its `Console Pin Gate` skip is now its one unexpected skip. A derived copy, with that one row concluding `success`, carries the OK-path cases. Two new cases tie the roster's absence to the live job's own `if:`.
3. `dispatch-gates`: a job's path population was read only from its job-level `if:`, so a pin-only diff stopped deriving `check:console-sha` / `check:console-injection`. The new rule (`stepFilterPopulations`): a job whose own `if:` is absent or `!cancelled()` alone is read step by step. When a step's `if:` passes the unchanged job-level whitelist, that step's checks get the population. The job-filtered tail walks the same steps. The 4 live console cases are unchanged. 12 new fixture cases and 1 live case pin the step-level shape.

## The instruction files stay true on both sides of the click

- `AGENTS.md`: "seven block (eight once Settings adds `Console Pin Gate`)". Where the sentence means the names the registry pins, "those seven" becomes "those eight".
- `platform-readings.md`: "objectstack 七个(`Console Pin Gate` 已登记,入 Settings 即第八)".
- Both files are at a zero-headroom line ceiling. The new words fill slack in an existing line, and no text moved between lines, so the files stay at 1116 and 469 lines.

## CI on this PR

`ci.yml` is in the `console` filter, so this PR gets an AFFECTED run: `Console Pin Gate` builds. ⛔ This PR does not exercise the unaffected leg (NOT BUILT, `success`) live. The conclusion read on this head is recorded in the os-dev-report on #17673.

## Verification (head d134f4cd0e, after one merge of `origin/main` at 2cf9db7c43)

- `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`: exit 0, 8 names pinned. Its `--self-test`: exit 0, 169 assertions.
- `check-expected-skips --self-test`: exit 0, 107 cases. Before this change it was 1 of 99 red.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet`: exit 0. `AGENTS.md` is 1116 lines against a ceiling of 1116, and `platform-readings.md` is 469 against 469.
- `dispatch-gates .objectui-sha`: base 43e17b8905 derives both console gates. Round 1's head fb32a5e1cf derives neither. This head derives both again, via "CI job filter for 'Console Pin Gate'".
- `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check-step-collectors`, `check-self-test-workflow-commands`, `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose` and `check:nul-bytes` all exit 0. actionlint is not installed here (NOT MEASURED).
- These were still running when this PR opened: the full `dispatch-gates --self-test`, the ablation that shows the new cases red on the job-level-only derivation, and the `--commands` sweep with `--ran` reconciliation. Their readings are in the os-dev-report on #17673.

## Landing

This PR touches governed surfaces: `AGENTS.md` (Tier H) and `.claude/**` (Tier S). It lands only by the maintainer's hand or after an authorized approval, and it stays draft. There is no changeset because no published package changes (`ci.yml`, `scripts/**` and two instruction files).
